note: DEFAULT LOCAL FRAME. Three markers: two balls on the baseline, one raised so the triangle is not flat. V is the Slicer cube; R defaults to the same device-local frame so the fit is ready at startup. With only three points the mirror ambiguity remains: keep the device face up, or add a fourth non-coplanar marker. If the real frame is the arm base, bench or plate, replace every R with the measured position; the rigid fit then maps V to that frame. The 20 mm z is a default, not a measurement.
